field.name: defaultCronExpression
field.description: The shipped Quartz cron. Only Darpan's own jobs have one; a job without it is never edited here.

field.name: defaultPaused
field.description: The shipped pause state (Y/N); blank reads as N.

field.name: minIntervalMinutes
field.description: The smallest gap, in minutes, any edited cron may leave between two runs; blank reads as 1.

field.name: resumePreviewService
field.description: A service that counts what the job would delete; resuming the job needs a fresh preview of it.

field.name: editedDate
field.description: When production last edited the cron, pause state or a parameter. Empty = follow the shipped defaults.

field.name: defaultValue
field.description: The shipped value; the live parameterValue follows it until someone edits the parameter.
